app.title: aivillage
gateway.title: CUSTOM AI GATEWAY
gateway.help: OpenAI Chat Completions compatible gateway. Tab or click to change fields; Enter saves.
gateway.security: Never enter a key here. Set its environment variable separately. Remote HTTP sends data unencrypted; prefer HTTPS.
gateway.invalid: Invalid URL, model ID or environment variable. URLs cannot contain credentials or query parameters.
gateway.save_error: Could not save gateway settings. Check the setup file and permissions.
gateway.saved: Gateway saved. Restart the game to connect.
model.title: MODEL FOR VILLAGER CHAT
model.help: Optional: enter a model ID already available from your selected provider. Leave blank to use your normal model. This only affects automatic villager conversations.
model.keyboard: Type a name · Enter saves · Esc cancels
model.invalid: Use a model ID with letters, digits, dots, dashes, slashes or colons.
model.save_error: Could not save the choice. Check file permissions or the setup file.
model.saved: Conversation model saved for future requests.
setup.title: AI SETUP
setup.choose: Pick an option, then follow the steps below:
setup.help_auto: Already set up an AI? The game will look for it. Or install and open Ollama, then download the free model below (about 2 GB).
setup.help_ollama: Install and open Ollama using its website. Then press Download model below (about 2 GB); keep Ollama running while you play.
setup.help_subscription: Install and sign in to Claude Code or Codex in a terminal first. The game tries Claude Code before Codex.
setup.help_claude_cli: Install Claude Code and run 'claude' in a terminal to sign in. Subscription limits and account requirements apply.
setup.help_codex_cli: Install Codex and run 'codex' in a terminal to sign in. Subscription limits and account requirements apply.
setup.help_openai: Put OPENAI_API_KEY in the .env file, or set it in your environment. An API key is not a ChatGPT subscription.
setup.help_anthropic: Put ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the .env file, or set it in your environment. An API key is not a Claude subscription.
setup.help_openai_compatible: Set llm.base_url and llm.model in config.toml for your compatible endpoint. Consult your provider for authentication.
setup.help_mock: Explore the village with simple preset test replies. This is not real AI and works without an account.
setup.help_none: The village runs without a model, but generated conversations and news retellings are unavailable.
setup.restart: Save the choice, then restart the game. No keys or passwords are stored by this screen.
setup.saved: Provider choice saved. Restart the game to connect.
setup.save_error: Could not save setup. Check the setup file and permissions.
setup.download_done: Model ready! Save your choice and restart.
setup.download_error: Download failed. Open Ollama, check your internet, and try again.
setup.download_local_only: Model download is available only for Ollama on this computer.
setup.browser_error: Could not open your web browser.
